reason: I'll start with the worn red cells to recover their iron for replacements, as the goal suggests.
expectation: The recycling cells will break down worn red cells and recover iron that the marrow can use.

alternatives.reason: Growing skin cells is the other clear goal, but I'll follow the red-cell route first.

effect: The old red cells have been broken down and their iron is available in the blood, so I can follow it to the marrow.
reaction: It is interesting that the iron is carried by proteins rather than appearing as metal fragments.
reason: I'll continue the red-cell route by supplying the recovered iron to the marrow.
expectation: I expect the marrow to use the iron while making new red blood cells, though I don't know whether another step will be needed.

alternatives.reason: Growing replacement skin cells is also a goal, but I want to finish following the iron first.

effect: The recovered iron is now part of haemoglobin in new red cells, and the marrow remains. The skin goal is next.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the iron reused while the marrow's stem cells remain.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it supplies the materials the dividing skin cells need to grow.
expectation: I expect the base cells to make replacement skin cells while some dividing cells remain.

effect: The skin result completes the chapter and shows new cells replacing shedding cells while the base population remains.
reaction: It is satisfying that the skin stays continuous during replacement.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following recovered iron into new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it made reuse across tissues clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing the skin cells was the least engaging choice because it was the only combination offered at that point, though the result was clear.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the recovered iron to travel in blood carried by proteins rather than appear as metal fragments.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; both routes had clear goals and supplied materials.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see more connections between body tissues, although the limited choices make it less compelling as a game.
